en-US.description: Save Outlook email messages outside of Outlook
en-US.longDescription: MessageSave is an easy-to-use, flexible and powerful product for saving, backing up, archiving and processing Outlook messages. The primary purpose of MessageSave is to save Outlook email messages outside of Outlook.
en-US.name: MessageSave
